Problem Statement:
Vaibhav loves to solve sudoku. He wants you to try solving a sudoku puzzle. As you are a beginner, he gives you a 4x4 puzzle. You have almost solved the puzzle but are just short of 1 number. You solve the puzzle but decide to write a program for solving the same. The program, when fed with a partially solved sudoku, returns a completely solved one. The places in the matrix with an unsolved sudoku value are marked with a 0. To make it easier, a constraint that every row and column can have a max of 2 unknown values is added.
